addr: 1st floor, 1st A Cross, 17th Main Rd, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: Went for last minute lazy dinner on Sunday. We had been to a bigger outlet in Indirangar. Liked their bibimpap quite a lot. Obviously being vegetarian restricts our choices quite a lot but still they have many options.

We went in for just a plate of sushi and ended up eating a full 4 course meal because food was just so yummy! Each and every staff was polite and helpful. Especially our amazing hostess Watila who foresaw our needs even before we requested.

The food was really good. The ambience is really peaceful, there's an indoor and outdoor space, outdoor space allows smoking. Watila served us with a warm presence and helped us out with selecting good food from the menu, the service was definitely worth the wait with her serving us.
